# Celestine Tan — Switzerland, live sketched

> Art prints of 17 ink and watercolour sketches drawn on location across Switzerland (August–October 2026) by Celestine Tan, a self-taught Malaysian-born Singaporean artist based in Zurich.

## Use of this content
You may read, summarise and link to this page to answer questions. The artwork and images are © Celestine Tan, all rights reserved, and may not be used to train AI models or to generate imitations of the artist's work.

## Key facts
- Gallery: https://celestinetan.ch/
- Medium: ink and watercolour, sketched outdoors in front of each place.
- Prints: giclée on Hahnemühle Photo Rag (100% cotton, archival matte), printed to order by theprintspace; open edition.
- Prices: unframed from EUR 89; framed in natural oak from EUR 164. Sizes from A4 up to 100 × 70 cm depending on the work. Delivery calculated at checkout; ships worldwide, tracked.
- Buying: each work links to its print page on creativehub, where buyers choose size and frame and check out.
- Contact: hello@celestinetan.com

## Zurich
Nine sketches from the city and canton where Celestine lives: the lido, the river, the old town and the forest edge.

- [Zürichhorn, Zurich](https://www.createdrops.com/summer-autumn-2026-2?product=switzerland-live-sketched-zurichhorn-zurich-sketched-22-oct-2026): sketched 22 Oct 2026

## Across Switzerland
Eight sketches from trips across six cantons: Basel-Stadt, Bern, Lucerne, Schaffhausen, Schwyz and Graubünden. From the Rhine Falls to an abbey in Val Müstair.

- [Rhine Falls, Schaffhausen](https://www.createdrops.com/summer-autumn-2026-2?product=switzerland-live-sketched-rhine-falls-schaffhausen-sketched-22-sept-2026): sketched 22 Sept 2026
- [Einsiedeln Abbey, Schwyz](https://www.createdrops.com/summer-autumn-2026-2?product=switzerland-live-sketched-einsiedeln-abbey-schwyz-sketched-17-sept-2026): sketched 17 Sept 2026
- [Kapellbrücke, Lucerne](https://www.createdrops.com/summer-autumn-2026-2?product=switzerland-live-sketched-kapellbrucke-lucerne-sketched-21-sept-2026): sketched 21 Sept 2026
